question: How many weeks of parental leave are employees eligible for?
expected_answer: Employees are eligible for 16 weeks of parental leave.

question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees receive?
expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave.

question: How many days of paid sick leave can employees take per year?
expected_answer: Employees may take up to 12 days of paid sick leave per year.

question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
expected_answer: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval.

question: How many times per year are performance reviews conducted?
expected_answer: Performance reviews are conducted twice each year.

question: When should employees normally submit expense claims?
expected_answer: Expense claims should normally be submitted within 30 days after returning from a business trip.

question: What are the standard working hours?
expected_answer: The standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

question: How many working hours are employees expected to complete per day?
expected_answer: Employees are expected to complete 8 working hours per day.

question: How many consecutive working days of sick leave may require documentation?
expected_answer: Sick leave lasting more than 3 consecutive working days may require documentation.

question: Can parental leave be divided into multiple periods?
expected_answer: Yes, parental leave may be divided into multiple periods subject to manager approval.
